purpose: Review-only multi-yaw deformation proof for selected refinement A2 across front, side, rear, and intermediate world rotations at four key motion states.
camera: one measured orthographic gameplay camera pitched downward exactly 45 degrees
facing: twelve real world-yaw samples from 0 through 330 degrees in 30-degree steps
lighting: approved neutral diagnostic body and orange independent rifle under identical controlled preview lighting
prompt: No generated imagery is used. Render selected mechanics refinement A2 at twelve true world-yaw rotations and four bounded motion states: left step, right step, four-degree peak recoil, and two-stage recovery tail. Preserve the exact 45-degree orthographic camera, complete approved source topology, independent rifle depth, floor contact, and both-hand plus shoulder-stock constraints.
negative_constraints: no whole-body pose spin in screen space; world yaw must rotate real 3D body and weapon geometry together
no camera pitch, camera scale, identity, material, lighting, framing, topology, or weapon-geometry drift between samples
no detached hand, floating stock, foot penetration, collapsed side or rear anatomy, broad translucency, or cropped silhouette
no 120-frame expansion, production atlas replacement, Player.gd change, collision change, or gameplay integration before review

references.role: selected A2 mechanics and motion language
approved grip deformation and depth proof
approved body geometry and complete topology

generation_model: Godot 4.7 inherited Skeleton3D A2 review rig, retained analytic arm and leg constraints, independent BoneAttachment3D rifle, and deterministic SubViewport rendering

technical_pipeline.renderer: Windows display driver with OpenGL3 compatibility renderer on NVIDIA GPU; never Godot headless/dummy for 3D capture
technical_pipeline.batching: four recoverable twelve-angle state batches, each submitted as twelve SubViewports in one render frame, followed by a no-render assembly step

selection_approval.scope: twelve directions and four key motion states accepted; next bounded topology and material previews only, not production integration
